changes: Desktop notifications for the same event appear once, and dismissing an alert clears matching alerts on other signed-in devices.
MakerWorld and Printables remember the page you were browsing after closing the browser or opening a downloaded model on Windows and Android.
Windows startup at sign-in now works for the Store app and respects the tray-only setting. App settings show the outcome of startup changes after refreshing.
MakerWorld model pages now keep the PrintStream action bar available whenever model import controls are present.
PrintStream now shows installed app and connected server versions separately, with app-specific release notes available from the footer.
Saved servers that are offline or unreachable now open a clear recovery screen with retry, server-switching, and browser options without forgetting your connection settings.
Self-hosted Android notifications are now encrypted for the enrolled device, so the PrintStream cloud relay cannot read their titles, messages, routes, or image links.
